unavailable_metrics.block_walkability_and_construction_volum: Eight-block samples cannot prove collision clearance, exact grades, road earthwork or tree-removal volume.
unavailable_metrics.cave_mouths_ravines_natural_bridges: Section-palette presence cannot locate entrances, tunnels, overhangs or bridge geometry.
unavailable_metrics.conservative_graph: Dry samples and rise-limited edges can miss traversable rough ground, bridges, boats and caves; disconnected is not physically impossible. Buildability is not a hard Wilderness travel gate.
unavailable_metrics.formation_semantics: Surface masks establish geographic candidates, not verified valleys, passes, saddles, landmark prominence or human-perceived interest.
unavailable_metrics.human_review: No human A.2 candidate selection or player-scale validation is supplied by this fitter.
unavailable_metrics.physical_network_connectivity: Finite surface costs include water opportunities; inferred joins and reachable bands do not prove block-level traversability or grade-separated intersections.
unavailable_metrics.resource_equivalence: No ore, food, animal, crop or full homeland resource portfolios in the committed grid.
unavailable_metrics.travel_time_hunger_and_level_access: Effective blocks are an explicit analytical cost, not measured time, Hunger expenditure or level gates.
unavailable_metrics.true_chokepoints: Surface clearance proxies cannot establish mandatory chokepoints with caves, boats and player modification available.
unavailable_metrics.visibility_and_landmark_prominence: No sightline/canopy-volume analysis; landmarks are surface-geography candidates.
unavailable_metrics.water_depth_and_fords: Water mask and terrain height do not provide a reliable water-column depth or crossing clearance.
